name: Mainspring Caldera
core_rationale: Central volcanic-brass crater of Continent 02 where Krono the Brass Titan's primary mainspring coil still beats, venting rhythmic steam plumes that drive the surrounding foundry towns.
local_conflict: Over-wound foundry automatons and steam-valve beetles have seized the main escapement bridge, threatening to over-pressurize the caldera vents.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Superheated solar-brass updrafts swirl around the Sun-Coil Spire; the Master Clockmakers have locked the lift until the barometer stabilizers are calibrated.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Master smiths claim the upper Sun-Coil Spire catches stray starlight from Continent 03 and stores it inside liquid-amber capacitors.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Concentric rings of glowing bronze flywheel bridges suspended above a steaming copper-slag crater.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: When will the Master Clockmakers unlock the northern Sun-Coil Spire sky-dock?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and connects West via the Flywheel Viaduct to Brass Spur Ridge in Rustcog Downs.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Concentric bronze flywheel bridges suspended over a rhythmic steam-venting mainspring crater.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Designed around 14.0 meter bronze flywheel highways, 0.16 meter cog-risers, and 0.60 meter anvil counters for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Orthogonal 2x2 grid with Caldera Rim [0,1], Escapement Anvil Town [1,1], Chronometer Foundry Dungeon [1,1, floor -1], and Sun-Coil Spire [1,0] (Fog of Lore) plus Level 24 to 32 construct/insect spawns.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Sun-Coil Spire frontier with a fog_of_lore portal and Master Clockmakers barometer rumor.
